item.title: Clocks spring forward March 8 as Daylight Saving Time begins
item.description: Residents across Louisiana are reminded to set their clocks forward one hour before going to bed Saturday night as Daylight Saving Time begins Sunday, March 8. item.title: Emergency 401(k) Withdrawals Now Allowed Without Early Penalty
item.description: By Journal Staff A federal law now allows workers to take a limited emergency withdrawal from their 401(k) retirement accounts without paying the traditional 10% early withdrawal penalty.
